title: Strict scalar comparisons and normalized tensor realizations
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E\subset L$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], schemes and their coefficient sequence systems [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site]. Use the actual sequence pullbacks, quotient scalar maps, scalar action unitors and successive scalar associators [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems]. Lift these to integer-indexed cochains. Comparisons records natural isomorphisms $\sigma:S\operatorname{Tot}\simeq\operatorname{Tot}(S,S)$ and $c:f^*\operatorname{Tot}\simeq\operatorname{Tot}(f^*,f^*)$, normalized on every local homogeneous tensor by $b\otimes(x\otimes y)\mapsto(b\otimes x)\otimes(1\otimes y)$. The chosen comparisons are the uniquely generator-normalized ones. Define leftRoute as scalar/pullback association, then pullback of $\sigma$, then $c_L$; define rightRoute as scalar image of $c_E$, then $\sigma$, then tensor of the two scalar/pullback associations. A TensorModel is a realization of the named completed tensor [def-pur-integral-derived-operations] by reduction, system tensor and total limit, normalized on every strict quotient presentation [def-pur-coefficient-reduction-presentation] by the balanced tensor generators and its fixed Roos bridge [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models]. Define scalar, pullback and tensor reduction comparisons by applying coherent reduction to the corresponding realization and then its counit [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data]. DerivedSigmaModel fixes the derived scalar/tensor comparison on flat-term K-flat systems [def-pc-kflat-complex], [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]; derivedSigma is the unique comparison with that normalization. modelSection reads a section in the normalized direct quotient model [def-pur-coefficient-extension-reduction-data]. These definitions include no equality of the two routes or completed coherence theorem.
